All traffic on Port 445 (SMB) from external IPs is strictly forbidden (WannaCry vector).
Port 3389 (RDP) must only be accessible via the VPN Gateway
Port 4444 is a known default listener port for Metasploit (High Probability of Compromise).
Port 6667 (IRC) is suspicious on enterprise servers often indicating Botnet C2 communication.
Outbound traffic to .onion domains or TOR exit nodes is a Policy Violation.
SSH Root login is disabled on all Linux servers; use key-based authentication only.
IP 203.0.113.55 is a known Command and Control (C2) server associated with APT29.
File Hash a1b2c3d4... is associated with the 'Emotet' banking trojan.
User Agent 'sqlmap' indicates an automated SQL Injection attack attempt.
Traffic volume > 1GB in under 5 minutes from a Critical Asset to an unknown external IP is a Data Exfiltration anomaly.
A process launching PowerShell with encoded commands is a behavioral indicator of a Zero-Day exploit.
Sudden modification of system logs or disabling of Antivirus by a non-admin user is a High Severity Alert.
Multiple failed login attempts followed by a successful login from a different geolocation indicates Credential Stuffing.
New unknown service listening on high ephemeral ports (49152-65535) on a Database Server is suspicious.
